summary: SciSparc Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing its subsidiary NeuroThera Labs' initiation of a Phase IIb clinical trial for SCI-110, a Tourette Syndrome treatment, at Hannover Medical School. No corporate transaction or special situation is involved; this is an operational update on clinical development. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, not triggering any special situations category.
